data.name: Nishan
data.gender_notes: Nishan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A symbol, mark, or sign. In Hindu mythology, a Nishan is a sacred symbol or flag used to represent a deity or a spiritual concept. The name Nishan carries the meaning “Symbol, Mark, Sign” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nishan usually hope their child will grow to embody symbol, mark, sign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of enlightenment and spiritual awakening
data.etymology: Nishan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Symbol, Mark, Sign.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nishan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
